subject: Intro: Redwood demo — pilot scope, traffic profile & scheduling
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Liu <jamie@shopfront.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Redwood demo — pilot scope, traffic profile & scheduling

Hi Jamie —

Thanks for signing up and for trying Redwood. I pulled your signup metadata and wanted to ask a few quick questions so we can make the demo useful and efficient (and I can loop in the right folks). If you can reply with short answers, we’ll lock a 30–45 minute session around the most relevant topics.

Quick qualifiers:
- Primary use case: search relevancy + long-form summarization (is that correct?), or are you leaning toward embeddings + rerank only?
- Expected traffic profile for pilot: average queries/day and typical request size (tokens per request or characters).
- Concurrency patterns: steady vs big daily spikes (what time zone/time windows do spikes occur in?).
- Timeline: when do you want a working pilot (2 weeks, 6 weeks, end of quarter)?
- Compliance/residency: you can flag if EU-only, SSO, or SOC2 evidence is required for the demo.

Proposed demo goals (can adjust):
1) Walk through architecture for search/embeddings workloads + integration points
2) Expected throughput/latency given your profile and cost split options
3) Pilot checklist & next steps (SLA, pilot scope, data handling)

I have these initial slots available (PDT):
- Tue 31 Aug 2027, 10:00–10:45
- Wed 1 Sep 2027, 14:00–14:45
- Thu 2 Sep 2027, 08:30–09:15

If none of those work, share 2–3 windows that suit you and I’ll loop in Ben (AE) and Lauren (Solutions). I attached our short demo deck so you can skim before the call (redwood-demo-deck.pdf).

Appreciate it — talk soon,

— Soojin
Soojin Lee | Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Jamie Liu <jamie@shopfront.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood demo — pilot scope, traffic profile & scheduling

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the quick follow-up. Quick answers below:
- Primary use case: yes — live search relevancy across product pages plus nightly batch summaries of product reviews (summaries fed to content team). We’ll likely use embeddings for similarity and a smaller generation path for summaries.
- Expected pilot volume: ~10k queries/day (avg), with request payloads ~200–400 tokens; summaries are larger (700–1,200 tokens) but batched overnight.
- Concurrency: steady daytime read volume with brief afternoon spikes (~+40%) UTC+1. Peak Q4 traffic projected to be 2–3x.
- Timeline: aim to have a pilot in ~6 weeks; production ramping later in Q4.
- Compliance: EU data residency is a must (we process EU customer content). SOC2 would be nice to see — can you share the report or a brief summary?

We’re technical so can do a 45-minute session focused on architecture, model sizing, cost estimates, and integration patterns (we’ll have our infra lead Sam join).

I’m available Wed 1 Sep 2027 14:00–15:00 CET (which I think matches your Wed 1 Sep 2027, 05:00–06:00 PDT — sorry for the awkward times). Better options: Wed 1 Sep 2027 09:00–09:45 CET or Thu 2 Sep 2027 10:30–11:15 CET.

If possible, can you also give a rough token-cost estimate for the 10k/day profile ahead of the call? A one-page pre-read would be great.

Thanks,
Jamie Liu
Head of Platform | ShopFront.ai
jamie@shopfront.ai
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Liu <jamie@shopfront.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood demo — pilot scope, traffic profile & scheduling

Jamie —

Appreciate the detail — that helps a lot. Looping in Ben (AE) and Lauren (Solutions) so we can cover pilot commercials and ops.

Ben / Lauren: ShopFront is targeting search + nightly summaries, ~10k queries/day, larger nightly batched summaries, EU residency required, pilot in ~6 weeks. They want a technical 45-min walkthrough with Sam (infra) joining.

Proposed slots (converted to CET to match Jamie):
- Wed 1 Sep 2027, 09:00–09:45 CET (Wed 1 Sep, 00:00–00:45 PDT)
- Wed 1 Sep 2027, 14:00–14:45 CET (Wed 1 Sep, 05:00–05:45 PDT) — Jamie flagged this but also offered alternatives
- Thu 2 Sep 2027, 10:30–11:15 CET

Agenda I attached: tailored demo agenda + suggested pilot acceptance criteria (redwood-tailored-agenda.docx). Ben, can you prepare a brief pricing sketch (ballpark token/costs for 10k/day + overnight summarization) so Jamie has something before the call? Lauren, can you bring the pilot checklist and minimal SSO/residency notes.

Jamie — if you pick a slot I’ll send a calendar invite and include Sam on the invitation.

Best,
— Soojin
From: Jamie Liu <jamie@shopfront.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 15:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood demo — pilot scope, traffic profile & scheduling

Thanks — and apologies, an internal planning conflict came up for our infra lead. Can we move to one of these windows instead (all CET):
- Fri 3 Sep 2027, 11:00–11:45 CET
- Mon 6 Sep 2027, 09:30–10:15 CET

Also, to help Ben’s prep: rough cost question — given 10k queries/day with ~300 tokens avg for search paths and 900 tokens avg for nightly summaries (batched, ~2k summaries total), what order of magnitude costs should we expect per day? Even a back-of-envelope in USD is fine. If you have a short worksheet, drop it here.

Finally, can you confirm EU-only hosting for pilot? We need to ensure data never leaves EU.

Thanks,
Jamie

Hi all —

Mon 6 Sep 2027, 09:30–10:15 CET works for us; locking that now and sending the invite to calendar. I attached a quick back-of-envelope cost sketch (rough-cost-estimate-10k-day.xlsx) — high level notes below:

- Search path (10k/day @ ~300 tokens): ~3M tokens/day => estimated raw inference cost band $X–Y/day depending on model/quantization; with batching & caching expect ~30–50% lower effective cost.
- Nightly summaries (2k summaries @ ~900 tokens): ~1.8M tokens/night; smaller models for summarization reduce cost further.
- Pilot estimate (conservative): expect single-digit $k/month for the pilot depending on model choice and caching.

Lauren will include residency/SSO checklist in the invite. Jamie — invite coming from my calendar in a minute; please accept and I’ll post the meeting notes + pre-read in the thread.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
